def evaluate_state(state_view, player_id):
    board = state_view.board
    captured = state_view.captured
    other = 1 - player_id
    own = board[player_id * 6:player_id * 6 + 6]
    opp = board[other * 6:other * 6 + 6]
    seed_diff = sum(own) - sum(opp)
    total = sum(own) + sum(opp)
    mobility_diff = (own[0] > 0) + (own[1] > 0) + (own[2] > 0) + (own[3] > 0) + (own[4] > 0) + (own[5] > 0) - (opp[0] > 0) - (opp[1] > 0) - (opp[2] > 0) - (opp[3] > 0) - (opp[4] > 0) - (opp[5] > 0)
    return max(-10.0, min(10.0, 0.90 * (captured[player_id] - captured[other]) + 0.16 * seed_diff / (1 + total) + 0.22 * mobility_diff))

thought: Tune g2-m2-02 by slightly increasing captured-lead influence and side-seed influence while keeping mobility secondary.

def evaluate_state(state_view, player_id):
    start = player_id * 6
    other = (1 - player_id) * 6
    board = state_view.board
    mobility = (1 if board[start] > 0 else 0) + (1 if board[start + 1] > 0 else 0) + (1 if board[start + 2] > 0 else 0) + (1 if board[start + 3] > 0 else 0) + (1 if board[start + 4] > 0 else 0) + (1 if board[start + 5] > 0 else 0)
    other_mobility = (1 if board[other] > 0 else 0) + (1 if board[other + 1] > 0 else 0) + (1 if board[other + 2] > 0 else 0) + (1 if board[other + 3] > 0 else 0) + (1 if board[other + 4] > 0 else 0) + (1 if board[other + 5] > 0 else 0)
    store_lead = state_view.captured[player_id] - state_view.captured[1 - player_id]
    side_lead = sum(board[start:start + 6]) - sum(board[other:other + 6])
    score = 2.6 * store_lead + 0.32 * side_lead + 0.4 * (mobility - other_mobility)
    return max(-10.0, min(10.0, score / 3.0))
